# Audit Colors

apps/web source/config plus packages/ui/src; excludes generated folders and test/spec files; includes registry, mock-data, store, JSON and comments. Lexical matches may include samples and data. JSX openings with nested <> or aliased imports need manual review. Reach is conservative static import closure including layouts, not runtime usage; unused exports inflate reach, unresolved package entrypoints/dynamic imports can undercount.

Scanned 409 files and 71 page route templates. Counts are literal source occurrences; reach counts route templates, never sessions or runtime screens. Full location arrays and route sets: [inventory.json](inventory.json). Reproduce: `python3 docs/design-system/inventory.py`.
